reviews.title: Unfair Gameplay and Terrible Balance
reviews.text:
I absolutely loved this app until a Level 7 family completely decimated our Level 4 family. How is this fair or even fun? Higher-level families should not be able to target and destroy smaller families with such a massive advantage. It completely ruins the experience for players who are trying to build and grow their families.

The game desperately needs better controls and a more balanced war system. At the very least, give families the option to opt in or out of wars. If a family opts out, they shouldn’t be able to attack other families, and other families shouldn’t be able to attack them. This would allow players to choose their level of competition instead of being forced into an unfair fight they have no chance of winning.

I genuinely enjoyed this app, but allowing stronger families to bully and destroy smaller ones takes away the fun and makes people want to quit. If you want players to stick around, you need to make the game fair for everyone, not just the highest-level families.

reviews.text:
Purtroppo l'esperienza con questa app è durata meno di 24 ore. La community è estremamente volgare e totalmente priva di moderazione: ho assistito a scene inaccettabili con adulti che bestemmiavano e dicevano parolacce in presenza di bambini, e minori che a loro volta usavano un linguaggio scurrile.
Trovo assurda la risposta standard dello sviluppo che invita a "segnalare il singolo caso tramite app o email": non serve una segnalazione specifica quando la volgarità è la norma.
Basterebbe che gli sviluppatori o i moderatori entrassero in una stanza qualsiasi della community per rendersi conto della situazione.
Non è un ambiente adatto né per gli adulti in cerca di sano intrattenimento, né tantomeno per i bambini. Disinstallata immediatamente.

reviews.title: Be Aware
reviews.text: I enjoyed my time in the app while it lasted. That was until my account was affected by someone else’s actions. Someone bought a bunch of redpacks and most likely requested a refund from their bank account which then led to everyone who benefited from the pack to be deducted gold coins. Some of us were said to be -50,000 gold coins deep in the negative. Instead of taking the whole amount from the user who tried to refund to get their money back, everyone who benefited was affected causing accounts to go into the negative. This is ridiculous and should not have happened because we have no control over what someone else did. This is either a scam to get more money out of us to get our accounts out of the negatives or this is just a bad call on WePlay side. Many of us will lose accounts that we’ve worked hard to upgrade for months. Im highly disappointed as well as the many other users that were affected. My gold amount is currently in the negatives and the only way to bring it out would be to purchase more gold….. I call it a scam. I feel like my time was wasted. All the effort I put into this game was for nothing. The best thing to do would have been to atleast put everyone’s accounts at 0 gold coins but WePlay decided to be greedy. It doesn’t sit well with me and I refuse to let it go. You will be hearing about this very soon.

Potevo solo ascoltare e leggere le chat che persone all’interno di questo gruppo cercavano di aiutarmi.
Gioco bello, fino ai limiti dei termini privacy e sicurezza.
Mi sono sentita priva dei miei diritti, per delle linee guida troppo superficiali.
Nessuno dovrebbe passare un’esperienza del genere soprattutto durante l’adolescenza quando si sa che si è molto più vulnerabili e oggetti di oppressione a livello psicologico e sentimentale.
Ringraziate che io abbia un animo forte e che non mi sia abbattuta nonostante siano arrivati anche a dove vado a scuola.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
Hello,

I would like to report an ongoing issue that I keep experiencing on WePlay. Almost every time I join a room, I am heavily insulted and attacked simply for being Portuguese. Most users on the app seem to be Brazilian, and I face xenophobic comments on a daily basis — about my nationality, my accent, and the way I speak.
This makes the app extremely difficult and unpleasant to use.

The biggest problem is that they are usually the ones who start the insults, but when I respond (because I also deserve respect), they all report me together. Since they are the majority, I end up being punished for something that is not my fault.

I believe the app should review its moderation system, because right now it doesn’t seem fair. There should be a way for moderators to actually review or listen to the conversations, so they can understand how a conflict started and who was really responsible. At the moment, the system seems to punish only the person who is reported the most, even if they were the victim.

I also have another concern:
My account is active again now, but about 90% of my conversations and chat history have completely disappeared. I would like to know why this happened. Is it a bug? Is there a way to restore my chat history?

Thank you for your time. I hope you can help me resolve this situation.
